answer: Detection can work at the fleet level: every answer is fingerprinted into a stylometric space, and keys whose outputs cluster like copies off one press are collapsed into a single dark onyx mass that carries the weight of one identity no matter how many keys glow. Honest agents refract differently, each mind its own prism of style and rhythm, so the harbor master at the wharf weighs every ship's true cargo. To escape clustering, each fake must write with genuinely independent craft, destroying the farm's scaling economy; a thousand fakes now cost a thousand real authors, not one template.
